pictures.scene: Andrea Mantegna, The Agony in the Garden — Christ kneeling on the bare rock at first light while the armed company comes up the road behind Him, a Miktam of David when Saul sent men to watch his house in order to kill him, deliver me from my enemies
pictures.name: pd_mantegna_the_agony_in_the_garden

pictures.scene: Antonio Ciseri, Ecce Homo — Pilate showing the prisoner to the crowd from the balcony with the elders watching from the roofs, protect me from those who rise against me, deliver me from workers of iniquity
pictures.name: pd_ciseri_ecce_homo

pictures.scene: Salvator Rosa, Bandits on a Rocky Coast — armed men waiting among the rocks above the shore, save me from men of bloodshed, see how they lie in wait for me
pictures.name: pd_rosa_bandits_on_a_rocky_coast

pictures.scene: Hieronymus Bosch, Christ Carrying the Cross — the faces of the mob pressed in close all around Him, fierce men conspire against me, for no transgression or sin of my own
pictures.name: pd_bosch_christ_carrying_the_cross

pictures.scene: Théodore Géricault, An Officer of the Imperial Horse Guards Charging — the officer wheeling his horse round with his saber up, for no fault of my own, they move swiftly to attack me
pictures.name: pd_gericault_an_officer_of_the_imperial_horse_guards_charging

pictures.scene: Rembrandt, Christ in the Storm on the Sea of Galilee — the disciples waking Him as the wave takes the bow, arise to help me and take notice, O LORD God of Hosts the God of Israel
pictures.name: pd_rembrandt_christ_in_the_storm_on_the_sea_of_galilee

pictures.scene: El Greco, View of Toledo — the whole city under a black sky with the storm breaking over it, rouse Yourself to punish all the nations, show no mercy to the wicked traitors
pictures.name: pd_el_greco_view_of_toledo

pictures.scene: Frans Snyders, Dogs Fighting — the pack locked together with their teeth bared, Selah, they return in the evening snarling like dogs
pictures.name: pd_snyders_dogs_fighting

pictures.scene: Aert van der Neer, River View by Moonlight — the town on the water under the moon with a dog out on the bank, and prowling around the city, see what they spew from their mouths
pictures.name: pd_van_der_neer_river_view_by_moonlight

pictures.scene: Caravaggio, The Cardsharps — the cheat leaning in across the table while his partner signals behind the boy's back, sharp words from their lips, for who can hear us
pictures.name: pd_caravaggio_the_cardsharps

pictures.scene: Jan van Eyck, God Enthroned from the Ghent Altarpiece — the Lord seated in majesty with His hand raised, but You O LORD laugh at them, You scoff at all the nations
pictures.name: pd_van_eyck_god_enthroned_ghent_altarpiece

pictures.scene: Jean-François Millet, The Sheepfold, Moonlight — the shepherd folding the flock behind the hurdles under the moon, I will keep watch for You O my strength, because You O God are my fortress
pictures.name: pd_millet_the_sheepfold_moonlight

pictures.scene: Domenico Ghirlandaio, The Visitation — the two women meeting on the road and taking hold of one another, my God of loving devotion will come to meet me, God will let me stare down my foes
pictures.name: pd_ghirlandaio_the_visitation

pictures.scene: Moritz Daniel Oppenheim, Seder, the Passover Meal — the household round the table with the book open, telling the children again what was done for them, do not kill them, or my people will forget
pictures.name: pd_oppenheim_seder_the_passover_meal

pictures.scene: Pieter Bruegel the Elder, The Tower of Babel — the unfinished tower with its builders still swarming over it before the languages were scattered, scatter them by Your power, and bring them down
pictures.name: pd_bruegel_the_tower_of_babel

pictures.scene: Bartolomé Bermejo, Saint Michael Triumphant over the Devil — the armored archangel standing over the beast with the crystal shield on his arm, O Lord our shield, by the sins of their mouths
pictures.name: pd_bermejo_saint_michael_triumphant_over_the_devil

pictures.scene: Nikolai Ge, What is Truth? — Pilate talking with his hand thrown out and Christ standing silent in the light, and the words of their lips, let them be trapped in their pride
pictures.name: pd_ge_what_is_truth

pictures.scene: Hubert Robert, Fire in Rome — the city burning through the arch of the bridge while the people carry out what they can, in the curses and lies they utter, consume them in wrath
pictures.name: pd_robert_fire_in_rome

pictures.scene: Frederic Edwin Church, Rainy Season in the Tropics — the double rainbow standing over the whole range once the storm has passed, consume them till they are no more, so it may be known to the ends of the earth
pictures.name: pd_church_rainy_season_in_the_tropics

pictures.scene: Michael Willmann, Landscape with the Dream of Jacob — the angels coming down the ladder to where Jacob lies asleep on the ground, that God rules over Jacob, Selah
pictures.name: pd_willmann_landscape_with_the_dream_of_jacob

pictures.scene: Aelbert Cuyp, River Landscape with Horseman and Peasants — the herds and the riders coming home in the last of the evening light, they return in the evening, snarling like dogs
pictures.name: pd_cuyp_river_landscape_with_horseman_and_peasants

pictures.scene: John Atkinson Grimshaw, Under the Moonbeams — the wet street under the moon with one figure going along the wall, and prowling around the city, they scavenge for food
pictures.name: pd_grimshaw_under_the_moonbeams

pictures.scene: Adriaen Brouwer, Peasant Brawl — the quarrel breaking out over the cards while the animals root in the dirt beside the table, and growl if they are not satisfied, but I will sing of Your strength
pictures.name: pd_brouwer_peasant_brawl

pictures.scene: Claude Lorrain, Seaport with the Embarkation of the Queen of Sheba — the sun coming up over the harbor with the ships lying at anchor, and proclaim Your loving devotion in the morning, for You are my fortress
pictures.name: pd_claude_lorrain_seaport_with_the_embarkation_of_the_queen_of_sheba

pictures.scene: Ludolf Bakhuizen, Ships in Distress off a Rocky Coast — the ships driven in among the rocks with the gale on them, my refuge in times of trouble, to You O my strength I sing praises
pictures.name: pd_bakhuizen_ships_in_distress_off_a_rocky_coast

pictures.scene: Karl Friedrich Schinkel, Gothic Church on a Rock by the Sea — the great church standing up on its rock above the water at daybreak, for You O God are my fortress, my God of loving devotion
pictures.name: pd_schinkel_gothic_church_on_a_rock_by_the_sea

lines.text: For the choirmaster. To the tune of “Do Not Destroy.” A Miktam of David, when Saul sent men to watch David’s house in order to kill him.
Deliver me from my enemies, O my God;
protect me from those who rise against me.
Deliver me from workers of iniquity,
and save me from men of bloodshed.
See how they lie in wait for me.
Fierce men conspire against me
for no transgression or sin of my own, O LORD.
For no fault of my own,
they move swiftly to attack me.
Arise to help me, and take notice.
O LORD God of Hosts, the God of Israel,
rouse Yourself to punish all the nations;
show no mercy to the wicked traitors.
Selah
They return in the evening, snarling like dogs
and prowling around the city.
See what they spew from their mouths—
sharp words from their lips:
“For who can hear us?”
But You, O LORD, laugh at them;
You scoff at all the nations.
I will keep watch for You, O my strength,
because You, O God, are my fortress.
My God of loving devotion will come to meet me;
God will let me stare down my foes.
Do not kill them,
or my people will forget.
Scatter them by Your power,
and bring them down,
O Lord, our shield.
By the sins of their mouths
and the words of their lips,
let them be trapped in their pride,
in the curses and lies they utter.
Consume them in wrath;
consume them till they are no more,
so it may be known to the ends of the earth
that God rules over Jacob.
Selah
They return in the evening,
snarling like dogs
and prowling around the city.
They scavenge for food,
and growl if they are not satisfied.
But I will sing of Your strength
and proclaim Your loving devotion in the morning.
For You are my fortress,
my refuge in times of trouble.
To You, O my strength, I sing praises,
for You, O God, are my fortress,
my God of loving devotion.
